GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
